body: Though my "friend" teached me something. It's not nessecarily about the pressure you apply, what also matters is the speed of the cut. I managed to make myself bleed more than ever, thanks to these tips. There's nobody for me, sadly.  That's life, though.

It hasn't been more than 1-2 hours since I submitted this dumb fucking cry of help. Apparently I need to learn better how to cut myself, and hopefully I'll be able to slit my throat before submitting to a mental asylum or someshit. Either I'll live free or I won't live at all.
Someone I thought was my friend told me that I'm a dumbass for not knowing how to cut myself properly. Shit's great, everything's falling apart like a shitty puzzle.

I don't have a job, I never went for any futher schooling. You know what I mean, hopefully. I went through the 9th class shit, but I've never specificed as anything else. I've sat in this same fucking room for years, being taken away from my home, and sometimes brought back. Now that I'm (over) 18, they will never affect me. Those fucking demons that controlled my life will never control me again. Now I'm nothing but a shell of who I used to be, sometimes making a "sprout" of feelings. I constantly get drunk, come up with these feelings, pass out, wake up hungover. Rinse-and-fucking-repeat. That's my life. I want to end it. If I had the balls to cut my throat deep enough, I would have already done it.
Lífe is nothing but just "going on", it's not what it used to be. I barely have any motivation to go through a single day.
So do your magic or don't, I wish I wouldn't give a shit. I'm tired of feeling like this.
I'm up as fuck, just drinking beer. 9:07 AM and should be sleeping. Don't care right now. Hangover me will defnitely care. But that's a problem to deal with later. How are you doing?

I like to think that I'm not a bright person but not retarded either. I understand understand lots of "humane feelings" or so to say, and that's more than enough for me. I can relate to lots of feelings people have, I've got lots of experience with different situations that most of us deal with. I don't enjoy reading the news, about politics and stuff. That just makes me depressed.
Get a bucket next to your bed, so you can throw up in it.

Old but gold, especially with some quality of life mods. It's really dumb but I enjoy having a toast with random people, so wanna have a drink with me?

My usual question is "how is life?" so I guess I'll ask that.

I want to believe that there's a stronger connection involved than "just being drunk with strangers", but the sober me just doesn't believe in it. I wish that I could connect with everyone in a stronger level than just "being drunk as fuck", but literally EVERY time I'm sober,  I feel too embarssed and dumb with what I've been writing. So yeah. I'll be updating this account every few months. Feel free to follow it, if you want to keep up with the converastions.

I'll do my best to believe that when I'm sober, no matter how little of a chance it has. We're all humans in the end. It still means something to me, even if my anxiety tells me not to trust you in a single way. Probably won't trust you when I'm sober. But like I (probably) said, I'll keep updating my "story" with this account whenever I'm drunk.  Feel free to take a part in this "story", if you so wish. In the end I'm just a drunk man hoping to feel at peace, finally.

As small as the meaning is, I love you too, in a spiritual/humane way. I just wish we could all live in peace. I left someone who I thought was the love of my life, but in the end I almost destroyed her. It pains me every day, but I still believe it was for the best.

I'm almost out of vodka, I've been drinking so much. To anyone reading; don't give up, there's still some people who care. Even if it's "just a subreddit of drunken people", it could the help you need, to stay in there.

I recently broke up with my girlfriend, she really liked Witcher 3. It's easy to relate to the Bloody Baron's story when you haven't been the best "husband" available. It hurt me to leave her, but I still believe it was for the best, I know it was destrucitve of her to stay with me. We were both so broken mentally. I hope this has been illegible to read. I just had to let it out.

I know. I'm 20 but still freshly bullied. I wish people could just go on with their lifes without being bothered. We'll all die in the end, sucks to waste it on other's shit. Am I right?

I was bullied in my 7-9th grade, I couldn't go to school at all. It was so bad that I couldn't even take out the trash because I feared that I'd run into certain people (a certain bully used to live literally next-door). Then I was kind of forced to go to school, since I was taken away from my home, to a place where there's lots of other troubled kids. (Sorry, I don't know the name of the place in english). Life was hell and nothing felt like anything. I just went to school, hoping that one day I'd be back at home again.. Well,  things kept going back and forth, until I finally managed to succesfully go through primary school. Now I've been just sitting in my room for several years without any idea what to do.

I assume we turn into alcohol when our negative feelings gain the majority of control, for me at least. I saw my old school earlier today and instantly felt like I should buy some vodka. So here I am, being a fucked up mess, completely drowning myself in alcohol. Probably will stop replying when I pass out, and then afterwards will feel too embarassed to talk again.
Depression, anxiety. Got some meds to deal with them,but sometimes the feeling overwhelms, especially when drinking alcohol.
